related.title: NIST Paul 離子阱：微運動與世俗頻率尺度
related.titleEn: NIST Paul ion trap: micromotion and secular-frequency scale
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付端到端時間帳、有效校準區間及吞吐／截止時間決策。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver end-to-end timing, calibration-validity intervals and throughput/deadline decisions. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『NIST Paul 離子阱：微運動與世俗頻率尺度』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付RF／世俗時間尺度圖、無量綱q表及穩定性證據缺口。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'NIST Paul ion trap: micromotion and secular-frequency scale', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver RF/secular timescale diagrams, dimensionless q tables and stability-evidence gaps.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：本機教學吞吐R=Nshots/(Tcal+Nshots·tshot)，不含網路排隊；一次校準可重用的範圍須由漂移資料支持。 使用合成Tcal=2 s、每shot=0.001 s、Nshots=1000。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1000/(2+1000*0.001)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：分別計算總時間3 s與6 s；檢查N很大時吞吐接近1000 shots/s而非無限。

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：在a≈0、小Mathieu q時ωsec≈qΩRF/(2sqrt(2))；這是穩定區內近似，未包含雜散場微運動。 使用教學q=0.2、ΩRF/(2π)=20 MHz；結果為fsec=ωsec/(2π)。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.2*20/(2*sqrt(2))，另開一欄執行獨立核對：用ωsec/ΩRF=q/(2sqrt2)作無量綱檢查；再比較小q假設，不外推q=2。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Local teaching throughput R=Nshots/(Tcal+Nshots·tshot) excludes network queues; calibration reuse needs drift evidence. Use Synthetic Tcal=2 s, tshot=0.001 s and Nshots=1000. Evaluate nominal expression 1000/(2+1000*0.001) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Calculate total times3 s and6 s; verify large-N throughput approaches1000 shots/s rather than infinity.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For a≈0 and small Mathieu q, ωsec≈qΩRF/(2sqrt(2)); this stable-region approximation excludes stray-field micromotion. Use Teaching q=0.2 and ΩRF/(2π)=20 MHz; output fsec=ωsec/(2π). Evaluate nominal expression 0.2*20/(2*sqrt(2)) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check dimensionless ωsec/ΩRF=q/(2sqrt2); retain the small-q condition rather than extrapolating to q=2.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NIST 共感冷卻：冷卻時間與聲子底限
related.titleEn: NIST sympathetic cooling: cooling duration and phonon floor
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付端到端時間帳、有效校準區間及吞吐／截止時間決策。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver end-to-end timing, calibration-validity intervals and throughput/deadline decisions. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『NIST 共感冷卻：冷卻時間與聲子底限』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付扣底限半對數圖、冷卻／等待整合帳與故障判別。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'NIST sympathetic cooling: cooling duration and phonon floor', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver floor-subtracted semilog plots, cooling/wait accounting and fault discrimination.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：本機教學吞吐R=Nshots/(Tcal+Nshots·tshot)，不含網路排隊；一次校準可重用的範圍須由漂移資料支持。 使用合成Tcal=2 s、每shot=0.001 s、Nshots=1000。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1000/(2+1000*0.001)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：分別計算總時間3 s與6 s；檢查N很大時吞吐接近1000 shots/s而非無限。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：教學一階模型n̄(t)=n∞+(n0−n∞)exp(−t/τc)；未包含模式間不同耦合與加熱再注入。 使用合成n0=2、n∞=0.05、τc=100 μs、t=200 μs。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.05+(2-0.05)*exp(-200/100)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：對n̄−0.05取log檢查斜率−1/τc；若直接對n̄取log，尾端將錯估時間常數。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Local teaching throughput R=Nshots/(Tcal+Nshots·tshot) excludes network queues; calibration reuse needs drift evidence. Use Synthetic Tcal=2 s, tshot=0.001 s and Nshots=1000. Evaluate nominal expression 1000/(2+1000*0.001) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Calculate total times3 s and6 s; verify large-N throughput approaches1000 shots/s rather than infinity.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Teaching first-order model n̄(t)=n∞+(n0−n∞)exp(−t/τc) excludes mode-dependent coupling and reheating. Use Synthetic n0=2, n∞=0.05, τc=100 μs and t=200 μs. Evaluate nominal expression 0.05+(2-0.05)*exp(-200/100) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Take log(n̄−0.05) to check slope−1/τc; logging n̄ directly misestimates the tail time constant.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
